question_text: Discuss a city’s proposal to replace independently operating traffic light controllers with one networked central controller.
adaptation_rationale: Retains real-world control application and modern networked infrastructure trade offs; no extra architecture taxonomy mandated.
solution: Central coordination can synchronize junctions in response to traffic.; Centrally updated rules can improve traffic flow across the city.; Central failure/network failure could disrupt many junctions simultaneously.; A justified balance should consider resilient local fallbacks and coordination benefits rather than claiming central control universally best.
